classification: Tier-1 financial (flag-seed migration + gates the six entity write-back paths). BUILD-SOLO-AND-HOLD — never self-merge; GUARD verifies independently, owner labels + merges.
task: IMPORT-P0b — entity-push kill-switch: gate every TMS→QBO write of invoice/bill/customer/vendor/account/item so nothing round-trips into QuickBooks under the parallel-books / reconcile-only architecture. Mirrors IMPORT-P0 (JE kill-switch, PR #1797).
details: Shared gate apps/backend/src/qbo/qbo-entity-push-gate.ts: LAYER-1 flag QBO_ENTITY_PUSH_ENABLED (default OFF, seeded via idempotent migration 202607021300, enrolled in POSTING_FLAG_KEYS → per-entity-only, global flip impossible) + LAYER-2 origin refusal (invoice/bill source_system!='tms' exact; masterdata qbo_*_id-presence APPROXIMATE + fail-closed). isEntityPushEnabled(client,opco) = LAYER-1-only helper for the choke points.

SCOPE EXPANDED beyond the six handlers after two independent reviews (7th-path recon + adversarial review) BOTH found the six-handler gate was a FALSE guarantee — four more ungated, default-ON/live paths reach the QBO entity write. Gating only the handlers would have shipped a kill-switch that doesn't kill. Closed the choke points instead:

(#1 live) sync-outbound-accounting.ts syncEntityToQbo gated journal_entry only (my own IMPORT-P0 code); extended to also gate invoice + bill (its own QBO POST, drained by the every-minute cron, actively enqueued from bills.service/recurring.worker). Same terminal semantics.

(#2/#3) deliverQboMasterEntityPush (push.service.ts) is the single QBO-write funnel for masterdata, reached by the default-ON schedulers sync/qbo-{customers,vendors,accounts}-push.ts AND the qbo.master_entity outbox handler — none passed the per-handler gate. Added the LAYER-1 flag check at that choke point → all of them now respect the flag (default OFF = zero QBO calls). This is the single most important fix (both reviewers).

The six tms-*-push.handler.ts handlers keep the full LAYER-1+2 gate in deliver() (before mirror upsert / token fetch) as an earlier-exit + origin layer; canHandle() neutralized to `return true` (the retired env-var TMS_*_PUSH_HANDLER_ENABLED default-ON gate — inert now; note for Render cleanup, render.yaml set none).

DEFERRED with reason (#4, MEDIUM): qbo-vendor-linkage.service.ts createQboVendor POSTs a vendor on driver-create, but createDriverWithQboVendor HARD-REQUIRES the qbo_vendor_id (throws qbo_vendor_create_missing_id if absent) — gating it would BREAK driver onboarding. Needs a product decision (does driver-create still create a QBO vendor under reconcile-only, or make it optional?). Not gated here; flagged, not silently excluded.

KNOWN LIMITATION (both reviewers, LOW): masterdata LAYER-2 over-refuses — once a TMS-created master row is synced once (qbo_*_id set), a later UPDATE push is refused as import_source even flag-ON. Safe now (flag OFF); the explicit origin/source column is a REQUIRED contract for MD-1/MD-2 before the flag is ever turned ON. Layer-1 default-OFF is the operative gate.

Static guard scripts/verify-qbo-entity-push-gates.mjs (registered in verify:arch-design): globs the handler folder (future handlers auto-covered), asserts each consults the gate before the push, and the gate keeps both layers. Proof harness: gate unit tests (8), invoice-handler fetch-spy zero-call (3), deliverQboMasterEntityPush choke-point zero-POST (1) — 12 green. Backend tsc 0 errors; migration idempotent (2x = 1 row, default OFF); outbound worker suite unregressed.
